description: Defines data structures and constants related to rendering layers in Android's render engine, including Buffer, Geometry, PixelSource, ShadowSettings, and LayerSettings, along with comparison and print functions.
external_methods: operator== (for Buffer, Geometry, PixelSource, ShadowSettings, LayerSettings)
PrintTo (for Buffer, Geometry, PixelSource, ShadowSettings, LayerSettings)

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Metadata describing the input buffer to render from, including buffer, fence, texture ID, and rendering options.

classes.name: Geometry
classes.description: Describes the layer's boundaries, transform, and rounded corners.

classes.name: PixelSource
classes.description: Descriptor of the source pixels for a layer, either from a buffer or a solid color.

classes.name: ShadowSettings
classes.description: Configuration for shadows associated with a layer, including colors, light position, and shadow parameters.

classes.name: LayerSettings
classes.description: Contains the configuration needed for rendering a layer, including geometry, source, alpha, color space, transforms, and shadow.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operators for the data structures.

methods.name: PrintTo
methods.description: Functions to output the data structures for testing and debugging.
